Fix in foundation 1.11.1 (library 90d766f), reviewer blocker on the site's Méthode switch: the gate acted on whatever element it was handed, so with ChannelSwitch holding the outgoing player through its fold while the step (src) changed, the new cycle paused / seeked the outgoing clip, accepted it on seeked and went ready before the incoming player existed; an incoming error was then masked (failed needs !ready). items.reason: Site port of navbar-idle-loops found that a ResizeObserver can't see a mark hidden by an ancestor clip-path (TextFill's lit copy), while an IntersectionObserver honours it. On the site the clipped copy was the costly one (layerize per frame). The library navbar's useLoop uses a ResizeObserver; today its marks sit in no clipped copy (pill ink declined), so this is a latent gap and a rule for any loop inside a liquid-fill copy.
evidence: site src/components/nav/finderShared.tsx useRestingBlink (IntersectionObserver), trace in .generated of the lane worktree

items.verify: Harness: re-show a rewound buffered clip, the open no longer waits the cap; showcase deck / title switches unchanged (animate() calls and timings vs master).
